messages:
olivia: posting a compact RN draft for the v2.3 rollout. Need copycheck + pin owner for the internal blast. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours, rollback gates at error spike >3x baseline or latency >600ms for 10m. short blurb below.

olivia: [RN draft]
• Feature: model quantization profile v2.3 with better throughput (~30% token/sec)
• Fix: reduce cold-start for KV cache priming
• Note: small change to routing policy for dedicated customers (fallback to v2.2 if GPU capacity constrained)

olivia: copy for internal announce: "Rolling out v2.3: faster token throughput and improved cache warmup. Expect a gradual rollout starting 14:00 UTC. Ops will monitor latency and error rates; automatic rollback enabled."

matt: thanks — timeline ok. who owns pinning for the canary route? I can take staging -> canary.

jordan: i'll own the rollback watch and final go/no-go. ping me at canary->25% threshold. I'll set the SLO alerts.

sarah: quick nits on copy: change "automatic rollback enabled" -> "automatic fallback and canary rollback thresholds configured". also add note about comms to customer-facing slack channel.

olivia: updated. adding model pin: model-redwood/v2.3.1-quant (pin to stack: inference-v2.3). anyone object to that id?

matt: lgtm. confirm deploy-bot commands?

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by @matt for 2025-06-10T14:00:00Z. job id: db-1790011223. commands: \n```\ndeploy-bot run db-1790011223 --stage canary --percent 5 --wait 300\ndeploy-bot promote db-1790011223 --percent 25 --wait 3600\ndeploy-bot promote db-1790011223 --percent 100\ndeploy-bot rollback db-1790011223 --reason \"rollback gate triggered\"\n```\n
matt: thanks. i'll kick off the run at 14:00 UTC and monitor.

jordan: i'll hook the pager to the canary alert and have the rollback playbook open (link: https://go/release/runbook/v2.3). if we hit error spike or latency gate, i'll trigger rollback.

sarah: can someone add a 1-sentence internal slack snippet? suggestion: "Heads up: v2.3 rollout at 14:00 UTC — improves throughput and cache warmup. Ops watching; will notify on status updates."

olivia: nice. i'll post that in #internal-release at T-15. also emailing the docs owners a short heads-up.

matt: one more ask — pin the DNS-weight fallback window to 10m after promote to 25% to avoid oscillation. set flag: --fallback-delay 600.

jordan: ack. adding to run params.

sarah: all set from docs side, i'll be on standby for quick copy edits during the run. :eyes: 

olivia: perfect. final checklist: model pin set, deploy-bot job scheduled, rollback watch assigned, internal blurb ready. go/no-go at 13:50 UTC for final green.

matt: will report status at 13:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: job db-1790011223 moved to queued state by @matt.
